log.text: Nuclear launch detected: Poland fired a nuclear missile at Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. Impact in 6 h.
Spain mobilizes. 67 rival powers are moving too.

papers.head: Quiet day on the fronts. Spain holds 34 provinces.
